title: 新艺术运动
scenePrompt: Art Nouveau. A luminous original stained-glass arched doorway with long sinuous iris stems, dragonfly wing glass details and whiplash wrought brass lines integrated into structure. Tight frontal architectural detail, asymmetrical flowering stems, translucent sea-green glass, amber luminous window panels, plum iris petals, elegant organic continuity. Palette sea green #648F83 amber #C89B48 plum #6A4566 ivory #EEE4CD. Not an existing building.
